dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Thank you for helping me clear those hilichurls out... Ahh, my nest is as warm as I remember! No more camping outside in the cold for me, no sir!

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: You have the clue, yes? Well, I hope you find the treasure you seek.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: Ah, you know... All those who bury their treasure wish for it to be found by people later on.
